q: How did Tigers crowds change in 2025, and why?
title: Detroit Tigers attendance changes and reasons, 2025
cited: The Detroit Tigers averaged 29,796 fans a game in 2025, 21.9% above the 24,433 their prior two years of crowds, win rate, and market would predict, up 25.1% from 23,824 the season before (table: team_season_model). Detroit welcomed 2,413,442 total fans to the ballpark in 2025, an increase of 555,147 fans over the 1,858,295 who attended in 2024 (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). This jump represented an average increase of 5,972 fans per game, with Comerica Park filling 72.53% of capacity in 2025 compared to 58.99% of capacity the year before, a rise of 13.5 percentage points (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). Public records do not contain details on the roster changes or team performance that coincided with the surge ([2025 Detroit Tigers season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Detroit_Tigers_season)).
report: The Detroit Tigers averaged 29,796 fans a game in 2025, 21.9% above the 24,433 their prior two years of crowds, win rate, and market would predict, up 25.1% from 23,824 the season before[1]. Detroit welcomed 2,413,442 total fans to the ballpark in 2025, an increase of 555,147 fans over the 1,858,295 who attended in 2024[2]. This jump represented an average increase of 5,972 fans per game, with Comerica Park filling 72.53% of capacity in 2025 compared to 58.99% of capacity the year before, a rise of 13.5 percentage points[2]. Public records do not contain details on the roster changes or team performance that coincided with the surge[3].

sources.query: select * from team_season_model where home_team = 'Detroit Tigers' and season = 2025

SELECT 2024 AS season_2024, t2024.official_home_total AS total_2024, t2025.official_home_total AS total_2025, t2025.official_home_total - t2024.official_home_total AS total_diff, t2024.avg_attendance AS avg_2024, t2025.avg_attendance AS avg_2025, t2025.avg_attendance - t2024.avg_attendance AS avg_diff, f2024.avg_fill AS fill_2024, f2025.avg_fill AS fill_2025, f2025.avg_fill - f2024.avg_fill AS fill_diff FROM team_season_model t2024 JOIN team_season_model t2025 ON t2024.team_id = t2025.team_id JOIN (SELECT season, AVG(fill_pct) AS avg_fill FROM games_clean WHERE home_team_id = 116 GROUP BY season) f2024 ON f2024.season = 2024 JOIN (SELECT season, AVG(fill_pct) AS avg_fill FROM games_clean WHERE home_team_id = 116 GROUP BY season) f2025 ON f2025.season = 2025 WHERE t2024.team_id = 116 AND t2024.season = 2024 AND t2025.season = 2025

data_note: Data sources: MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com); Wikipedia.

q: Compare the Cubs and White Sox on attendance and national TV audiences in 2025.
title: Cubs and White Sox attendance and TV, 2025
cited:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Chicago White Sox in 2025, outdrawing them by 19,187 fans per game and drawing a massive national television audience while the White Sox had none (table: team_season_model; table: team_tv_summary; query: Q6).

### Attendance
The Cubs averaged 37,259 fans per game, which was 320 fans above what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). Wrigley Field drew 89.9% of capacity (table: games_clean), bringing their season total to 3,017,983 fans, 1,572,245 more fans than their crosstown rivals overall (table: team_season_model; query: Q5, Q3, Q6). Meanwhile, the White Sox averaged 18,072 fans per game, which was 1,548 fans below what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). Guaranteed Rate Field drew 45.0% of capacity (table: games_clean) for a total of 1,445,738 fans (table: team_season_model; query: Q5, Q3).

### National TV Audiences
The Cubs averaged 1,126,444 viewers across their 15 national TV appearances in 2025 (table: team_tv_summary). The White Sox had no national TV broadcasts in the 2025 data (table: team_tv_summary).
report:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Chicago White Sox in 2025, outdrawing them by 19,187 fans per game and drawing a massive national television audience while the White Sox had none[1].

### Attendance
The Cubs averaged 37,259 fans per game, which was 320 fans above what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict[2]. Wrigley Field drew 89.9% of capacity, bringing their season total to 3,017,983 fans, 1,572,245 more fans than their crosstown rivals overall[3][2][1]. Meanwhile, the White Sox averaged 18,072 fans per game, which was 1,548 fans below what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict[2]. Guaranteed Rate Field drew 45.0% of capacity for a total of 1,445,738 fans[3][2].

### National TV Audiences
The Cubs averaged 1,126,444 viewers across their 15 national TV appearances in 2025[4]. The White Sox had no national TV broadcasts in the 2025 data[4].

*Viewership figures are publicly reported and may differ from official Nielsen data. They are the national TV audience, excluding streaming add-ons.*

sources.query: SELECT cubs.avg_attendance - sox.avg_attendance AS attendance_diff, cubs.official_home_total - sox.official_home_total AS total_diff FROM (SELECT avg_attendance, official_home_total FROM team_season_model WHERE season = 2025 AND team_id = 112) cubs, (SELECT avg_attendance, official_home_total FROM team_season_model WHERE season = 2025 AND team_id = 145) sox

SELECT tsm.home_team, tsm.official_home_total, tsm.avg_attendance, tsm.expected_avg_attendance, (tsm.avg_attendance - tsm.expected_avg_attendance) AS expected_difference, tsm.residual_pct FROM team_season_model tsm WHERE tsm.season = 2025 AND tsm.team_id IN (112, 145)
SELECT home_team, avg(fill_pct) as avg_fill_pct FROM games_clean WHERE season = 2025 AND home_team_id IN (112, 145) GROUP BY home_team
SELECT * FROM team_tv_summary WHERE team_id IN (112, 145) AND season = 2025

data_note: Data sources: MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com); TV Media Blog MLB viewership archives ([2025](https://tvmediablog.substack.com/p/2025-mlb-season-viewership-database), [2026](https://tvmediablog.substack.com/p/2026-mlb-viewership-archive)).
